title: "Draw me a curator" Examining the visual stereotyping of a cultural services profession by generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images of museum curators using ChatGPT4o/DALL-E with unconstrained prompts, coding the perceived gender of the depicted subjects, and comparing the resulting ratios to real-world occupational demographics.

Categorizing the perceived age (young, middle-aged, old) of AI-generated museum curators based on facial features and hair coloring, and comparing the distribution to real-world workforce age profiles.
Assessing the perceived race and ethnicity of AI-generated curators and contrasting the findings (which were 100% Caucasian) with real-world diversity statistics for the profession.

Analyzing AI-generated images of museum curators for stereotypical visual attributes and cues, such as clothing styles (formal vs. informal), facial hair, glasses, and professional props (e.g., clipboards, tablets, name tags), across different types of museums.
